claims.sourceText: Northrop Grumman Corporation, Form 8-K, earliest event 11 December 2002, Item 2, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1133421/000089843002004580/d8k.htm
claims.text: The Northrop Grumman merger closed on a stated date: 'Pursuant to the merger agreement, on December 11, 2002, Richmond Acquisition Corp. was merged with and into TRW, with TRW surviving the merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Northrop Grumman.' The exchange ratio was 0.5357 Northrop shares per TRW share.

edges.label: Merged into a Northrop Grumman subsidiary, 11 December 2002
edges.note: Northrop Grumman's Form 8-K states that Richmond Acquisition Corp. merged with and into TRW on 11 December 2002, leaving TRW a wholly owned subsidiary, with TRW Systems and TRW Space and Electronics renamed as Northrop Grumman Mission Systems and Northrop Grumman Space Technology.
